observations: Photo 0: Front view of a Dell laptop with a black screen, keyboard, and trackpad. The Dell logo is visible below the screen. A sticker on the bottom right of the keyboard area shows 'Intel Core i7' and '10th Gen'.

Photo 2: Another angle of the closed laptop on the same blue surface, showing the textured lid and Dell logo. The left side ports are visible again.
